## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link any relevant issue.

## Validation

State which host checks, build, renderer previews and physical device checks you ran. Mark anything untested; a passing build is not a hardware test.

## Attribution

If this change uses another project's code or assets, link the source and license, describe adaptations, and update `THIRD_PARTY.md`, `NOTICE` and `licenses/` as applicable. Write “No new third-party material” otherwise.

- [ ] I have reviewed the diff for private data and generated build/backup files.
- [ ] I have kept applicable copyright and license notices.
